Name: Zephaniah, Second Priest
Summary: Zephaniah the second priest was taken with Seraiah after Jerusalem's fall and slain at Riblah by the king of Babylon; he is distinct from Zephaniah the prophet.
RelatedPeople: Nebuzaradan, Captain of the Guard; Seraiah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Second in office, first in suffering: exile made no distinctions.
